entries.answer: Each tree you HEADBUTT is common, rare or almost empty, picked from where the tree stands and your trainer ID. HERE lists both tables; try every tree on a route to find the rare ones.
entries.hint: It has to do with your trainer ID.
entries.title: Why do some trees never have the rare POKéMON?

randomized.answer: The game's clock has three times of day: morning from 4 AM, day from 10 AM and night from 6 PM. Grass and caves have a list for each, and HERE shows the one for the time your game's clock says.
randomized.title: Why did the POKéMON on this route change?
